title: Colletotrichum sublineola observation resource: verification code

creators.name: Ahn, Ezekiel
creators.affiliation: Sustainable Perennial Crops Laboratory, USDA Agricultural Research Service

description: Verification code for a Colletotrichum sublineola host-reaction and genomic-observation resource. It checks archived data, recounts read support and observation masks, and reproduces the tables and figures. Research data are distributed separately.
